note: Medicine Bow-Routt NF campground beside 55-acre Lake Owen in the Snowy Range foothills, reached from Albany by Forest roads 500, 513, 517 and 540. Two loops among lodgepole pine and aspen on a grassy slope, many sites looking over the lake to the Snowy Range; boat ramp. The FS caps camping trailers at 22 ft, so a 23-ft rig is at the limit, though the driveways are mostly 30-50 ft. --Claude
